Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

</details>


### [321] [Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23056)
*Kai-Hsin Chen,Wei-Yu Chen,Xuanjun Chen,Jyh-Shing Roger Jang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文比较了agentic（自适应）RAG和静态RAG在台湾历史问答任务中的表现，发现两者各有优劣，单一流水线并无绝对优势，结合两者可提升整体表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前agentic RAG可以根据已有证据动态调整检索过程，但尚不清楚其是否总是优于精心设计的静态RAG流水线。作者希望通过实验证明不同策略的优劣，并探索更优组合方式。

Method: 作者对agentic和static两种RAG流水线在同一问答生成器和混合检索后端下进行对比实验。针对台湾历史问答数据集，分析两者在单题和整体层面上的表现差异，并设计oracle选择器与后处理选择器，从两者生成的答案和引证依据中选择更佳答案。

Result: 虽然整体成绩相近，但两种策略在70.83%的问题上答案不同，优势基本相互抵消。若每题选更佳答案，复合分数比最优单一流水线提高0.2417。引入的后处理选择器能显著提升表现，回收60.34%的oracle提升空间。

Conclusion: 单纯对比两种RAG的整体表现会掩盖关键的单题差异，未来可通过利用二者互补性，而非追求唯一最优流水线，进一步提升问答系统效果。

Abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

</details>


### [322] [From Concept Alignment to Causal Grounding: An Intervention Test of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23065)
*Qianli Wang,Yilong Wang,Dennis Wei,Jingyi Sun,Simon Ostermann,Pepa Atanasova,Nils Feldhus*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出用内部概念对齐和因果检验方法，更深入地评估大型语言模型（LLM）链式思维（CoT）推理的诚信性，发现现有的表层或表征指标难以全面刻画其真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去关于链式思维推理诚信性的评估多局限于输入输出或归因分析，很少探究模型内部的真实推理过程。这导致缺乏对模型推理与输出一致性的深度理解。该工作旨在弥补这一空白，提出更深入的、基于内在概念的测量方法。

Method: 提出用稀疏自编码器（SAE）统一编码模型的直接预测和CoT预测过程，从而使内部概念可比。通过三种相关性指标度量概念层面对齐程度，同时引入$Δp$因果指标，通过消融共有概念观察输出概率下降，直接反映共享概念对推理结果的因果贡献。

Result: 在五个LLM和四个数据集上实验，相关性指标显示概念对齐普遍较高；但真正具因果意义的诚信性随模型深度变化显著，在中后层达到峰值。此外，并非所有对预测因果重要的概念都在CoT中显式表述。概念层面对齐与因果贡献两者间存在较大差异。

Conclusion: 仅凭输入输出或表层表征分析无法充分评估链式思维推理的诚信性，须依靠因果检验模型内部概念，才能理解CoT过程与最终预测的一致性。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $Δp$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. Across five LLMs and four datasets, concept alignment is generally high, as indicated by the correlational metrics; yet these only identify which concepts are shared, not how much they causally contribute. $Δp$ fills this gap: causal faithfulness varies substantially with model depth, peaking at mid-to-late layers rather than the final ones, and model scale reshapes the layer-wise profile. Moreover, causally important shared concepts are not always verbalized in the CoT. These dissociations suggest that faithfulness cannot be reliably assessed from surface-level or representational correspondence alone; assessing it requires causal tests of whether the internal concepts underlying a CoT actually drive the model's prediction.

</details>


### [323] [Directing large language models to follow the letter or spirit of the law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23083)
*Peng Qian,Andrew Li,Sam Chen,Sonia K. Murthy,Yonatan Belinkov,Tomer D. Ullman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了机器如何理解和遵循法律的“精神”与“字面”规则，并通过对大语言模型的有针对性适配，显著改变了其在法律情境中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人工智能的发展，让机器不仅理解法律条文，还能领会其背后的意图，成为构建安全智能系统的关键问题。

Method: 对大语言模型采用有针对性的适配，使其更加侧重于“法律精神”或“法律字面”，并测试其在多样化的情景下的表现。

Result: 通过极少的模型修改，模型在不同法律场景下的行为有明显转变。通过对模型内部分析，发现其表征空间可被三大可解释维度描述，并与现有法律几何概念框架吻合。

Conclusion: 研究表明，法律思维可在大语言模型中有组织地实现和调控，为智能体正确理解和执行规则提供了理论与实践基础。

Abstract: The distinction between the spirit and letter of the law is a central issue across research and everyday life, and a growing concern for building safe, intelligent machines. What is this distinction based on, and how can we develop machines that follow the intention behind a rule? We used targeted adaptation that made large language models prioritize the spirit or letter of the law. With minimal modifications, our method significantly changed LLM behavior across diverse measures, novel vignettes, real-world scenarios, and influential legal cases. An analysis of model internals revealed a low-dimensional space with three interpretable dimensions matching a formal pre-specified framework for the geometry of legal concepts. These findings show how legal thought in LLMs may be organized and directed.

</details>


### [324] [OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23088)
*Hao Liang,Qihan Lin,Meiyi Qiang,Linzhuang Sun,Hengyi Feng,Mingrui Chen,Sizhe Qiu,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OmniEdu是一套面向K-12教育领域的大模型，覆盖问题解答、课程理解、学习诊断和教学支持，经过有针对性的调优后，在多项教育基准测试上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的教育语言模型多只关注单一能力（如解题或辅导），且训练数据按来源/任务组织，这限制了模型多元教育能力的发展。作者希望构建可同时胜任多种教育任务的基础大模型。

Method: 提出OmniEdu模型族，整合超过100种教育及通用指令数据源，围绕学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理和教学支架四大能力进行分组整理。建立数据清洗、语义审核、质量打分、样例多样性控制及教学指令分配等流水线，产出约7万条标注数据，分别微调了4B、9B、27B规模模型。

Result: 在K12-Bench、MathFish、EDUMATH、MathTutorBench等多个教育任务和基准测评中，OmniEdu模型在不同规模下均显著优于未调优模型，OmniEdu-27B在所有测试中取得领先分数。

Conclusion: 针对教育四大能力的均衡调优显著提升了大模型的综合教育能力，证明了精心策划的数据和能力驱动调优策略能更好地适配广泛的教育任务。

Abstract: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.

</details>


### [325] [Chronologic: Measuring Language Models' Ability to Represent the Past](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23178)
*Ted Underwood,Ziliang Qiu,Sarah Griebel,Laura K. Nelson,Edwin Roland,Wenyi Shang,Matthew Wilkens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过历史文本验证语言模型再现1831-1930年英语环境能力的基准方法，并评估不同模型的表现。结果显示，目前模型尚未能完全准确地还原历史语境，但已有进步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能作为研究过去的有力工具，但学者需要验证其生成内容是否真切符合特定历史时期的语言环境，而常规验证难以实现，需系统方法。

Method: 作者利用1831-1930年间的历史文本，设计了基于成对比较、多个参考答案、以及针对难题的分层评分机制的实验基准，以全面测试模型对历史语境的把握能力，涵盖生成式与判别式任务。

Result: 结果发现：生成式任务难度大于判别式任务，且推理型模型往往能识别自身答案的不足。仅用历史文本预训练的模型在答案概率估计上表现较好，但在自由生成任务中不如商业大模型。

Conclusion: 尽管目前还没有模型能完全令人信服地再现历史语境，但研究显示了显著进步，为更好复现历史语境的模型开发提供了方向。

Abstract: Language models are appealing tools for research on the past. But to trust the evidence a model provides, researchers need to know whether its responses fit the period represented. Validation is challenging, because this is not a task living people ordinarily perform, and because many questions have multiple correct answers. We use historical texts to develop a benchmark for a model's representation of English-language contexts 1831-1930, relying on pairwise comparisons to multiple ground truths and strong distractors to score the hardest questions in an appropriately graduated way. We find that generative tasks are harder than discriminative ones; in fact, reasoning models can typically discern the weakness of their own generated answers. While models pretrained exclusively on historical text lead the pack when evaluated by answer likelihood, they cannot compete with commercial models in free generation. None of the models we tested represent historical contexts in a fully persuasive way yet, but progress toward that goal is evident.

</details>


### [326] [Low resource cross-modal alignment using HGNN to enhance speech representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23191)
*Yannick Yomie Nzeuhang,Marie Tahon,Paulin Melatagia Yonta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种基于异构图神经网络与链接预测的数据高效型语音文本空间对齐方法，在资源有限的条件下实现了与主流方法相当甚至更优的效果，并显著降低了对数据和算力的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音文本空间对齐方法（如SAMU-XLSR）依赖大量训练数据和计算资源，难以应用于低资源语言。这促使作者探索更节省资源的方法，以便在数据或算力有限时仍能实现多模态对齐和语义信息传递。

Method: 作者提出利用异构图神经网络（Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks）及消息传递机制，实现文本模态向语音模态的信息转移，通过链接预测进行空间对齐，提升语音表示的语义丰富度，且减少了对大规模数据集的依赖。

Result: 在英文（TIMIT）与喀麦隆Yemba语料上进行词级实验，所提方法在资源需求大幅下降的前提下，取得了与SOTA方法SAMU-XLSR相当的表现，并在Yemba语言的词检索任务上超越了后者。

Conclusion: 论文证明了提出的基于异构图神经网络的空间对齐方法在数据和算力有限场景下的有效性、节约性和高效性，拓宽了低资源语言下多模态任务的应用前景。

Abstract: Speech-text space alignment is a multimodal representation learning method consisting to map different speech and text into a shared representation space, leading to enrichment of the representation of each modality. Proposed architectures, such as SAMU-XLSR, typically follow a student/teacher framework, with the goal of fine-tuning an audio encoder to produce representations that closely match those of the text. In this way a speech representation is semantically enriched. However, such systems generally require large amounts of training data and considerable computational resource, making them difficult to apply to low resources languages under frugal constraints. The present work proposes a data-efficient space alignment method based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks and link prediction. The core idea is to leverage message passing to explicitly transfer information from the text modality to the speech modality, thereby reducing the need for large training datasets and intrinsically enriching the acoustic representations, all in a more interpretable manner. Although thoroughly explored for high-resource languages, word-level tasks in speech remain relevant for certain low-resource languages. Therefore, we conducted experiments on speech-text alignment at the word level using the TIMIT (English) dataset and Yemba (a Cameroonian language). Our approach yields results comparable to those of SAMU-XLSR, a state-of-the-art method, and even surpasses it for the Yemba language in the task of word retrieval, while using far fewer resources, demonstrating its power, frugality, and efficiency.

</details>


### [327] [Enhancing speech representation learning with cross-modal knowledge transfer with HGNN under low resource settings: the case study of Yemba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23194)
*Yannick Yomie Nzeuhang,Paulin Melatagia Yonta,Marie Tahon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用异构图神经网络（HGNNs）进行跨模态知识迁移，以提升低资源语言中的音频特征表征能力。实验结果显示，这种方法能显著提升音频表征与识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言由于可用语音数据不足，导致现有传统和自监督模型效果有限。为缓解数据稀缺问题，探索新的跨模态信息迁移方式成为关键需求。

Method: 将音频和语言实体分别作为节点类型，构造统一异构图，通过消息传递机制将语言节点的知识“显式”传递到音频节点，实现结构化和可解释的跨模态知识流。

Result: 通过标准聚类指标和孤立词识别任务，在英语基准集和喀麦隆语言低资源数据集上评估。结果显示，模型学习到的音频表征在低资源场景下受益明显。

Conclusion: 这是首次在音频表征学习中，利用HGNNs实现显式跨模态知识传递，证明该路线在低资源语音表征中极具前景。

Abstract: Acoustic representation learning is crucial for speech processing, yet low-resource languages (LRLs) face severe data scarcity, limiting the effectiveness of traditional and self-supervised methods. As a promising alternative, in this work, we propose to enhance acoustic representation trough a cross-modal transfer knowledge approach, based on heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs), where acoustic and linguistic entities are modeled as distinct node types within a unified graph. Through message-passing mechanisms, linguistic nodes explicitly transfer knowledge to acoustic nodes, enabling structured and interpretable cross-modal information flow. To highlight this knowledge transfer and its benefits, we measured standard clustering metrics as an intrinsic evaluation of acoustic representation, and to emphasize applicability, we performed isolated-word recognition tasks using an English benchmark and a Cameroonian language dataset in low resources settings . Results demonstrate that acoustic representations consistently benefit from linguistic knowledge propagated through the graph. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of explicit cross-modal knowledge transfer for acoustic representation learning using HGNNs, highlighting a promising direction for speech representation in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [328] [Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23205)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个能够更好拒绝错误数学命题的语言模型Euston，并通过改进的数据生成与模型训练方法，实现了更高的真伪鉴别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流大语言模型通常缺乏对错误问题的识别和拒绝能力，即使被要求证明错误命题，也常会自信地给出推导，导致生成不实内容。尤其在数学领域，这一问题尤为突出。因此，亟需有能力识别并拒绝错误命题的模型，提升其验证能力。

Method: 作者构建了GraphSynth工具，用于生成多样化、结构化的数学命题，并将其分为真实与经过扰动的伪命题，共计采集3,026对配对命题（共6,052条语句），覆盖2010-2025年arXiv论文。基于这些数据，作者采用GRPO规则为基础的奖励机制对DeepSeek-R1-8B模型微调，训练189步。

Result: 在400条数据（200真/200假）的测试集上，新模型判别准确率从29.50%提升至63.75%，假命题识别率明显上升。与此同时，在AIME 2026官方数学题集上，模型准确率由69.17%仅下降至65%，没有显著损失数学解题能力。模型生成文本长度和截断率也下降，表明准确率提升非由更长推理获得。

Conclusion: 通过专门的数据与训练方法，模型对错误命题的鉴别能力大幅提升，同时不牺牲数学总体能力。作者指出，实验存在如评价集全部为假命题等局限性，但该工作为改善大模型事实拒绝能力提供了新思路。

Abstract: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to decode-time structural masking and span-synchronized verification, yielding 3{,}026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs (6,052 statements) drawn from arXiv papers spanning 2010--2025. We fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-8B with GRPO under a rule-based, zero-API reward for 189 steps on four H100 GPUs. On a balanced 200-true/200-false held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% and the discrimination gap---the difference between the rate of calling false statements false and the rate of calling true statements false moves from -0.5% (z=-0.1) to +27.5% (z=+6.0). Critically, the gain is not purchased with general mathematical ability: AIME 2026 accuracy under official semantics is 65.00% against a 69.17% base, a difference of -4.17% that is not statistically significant, whereas an earlier run of the same recipe on a smaller GraphSynth corpus collapsed to 40.00%. Median response length also falls from 19,217 to 18,296 tokens and the truncation rate from 25.8% to 8.3%, so the improvement does not come from thinking longer. We report the result together with the confounds that bound its interpretation, principally the all-false composition of the official evaluation sets and the low precision implied at realistic error prevalence.

</details>


### [329] [ChemCLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Multilingual Chemical Patents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23231)
*Mahdi Astaraki,Mohammad Khodadad,Reza Namazi,Mohammad Arshi Saloot,Amir Reza Behzad Moghadam,Hamidreza Mahyar,Soheila Samiee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对化学领域专利数据，构建了一个多语言跨语言检索(CLIR)基准，系统评测了8种主流嵌入模型，揭示了在跨语言环境下模型表现与单语言场景的显著差距，并提供了可诊断和分析CLIR局限性的基准和工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多国工业应用中，关键性技术证据常以不同语言存在，现有CLIR基准难以反映特定领域中的跨语言检索深度及可恢复性等问题。因此，急需更贴合实际应用场景的跨语言检索评测方案。

Method: 作者以专利为对象，从Google Patents及EPO获取多语言（五种主流东、西方语言）数据，构建了覆盖工业技术文档多样性和复杂性的基准数据集。然后对8个当前最先进的嵌入式模型进行系统性CLIR性能评测，特别关注检索深度和相关文档在检索排名中的可恢复性。

Result: 实验发现，无论是召回率还是检索深度，跨语言检索均明显逊色于单语言检索。例如，在Recall@10指标下，最佳模型从0.72降至0.53。部分在单语环境下表现良好的多语种模型在跨语场景中显著退化。

Conclusion: 现有的跨语言方法在专利领域实际应用中存在突出短板，需研发更健壮的跨语言检索技术。本文基准数据和分析工具能够为模型选择与CLIR研究提供实用参考和诊断框架。

Abstract: Cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) is increasingly important in multi-national industries, where critical technical evidence may exist in a different language than the query. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately capture domain-specific cross-lingual retrieval or the retrieval-depth and recoverability failures that aggregate recall hides.
  In this work, we benchmark CLIR in the chemical domain, with a focus on patent data. We construct a multilingual dataset from Google Patents and the European Patent Office (EPO) data, spanning five languages (covering major Eastern and Western languages) and reflecting the diversity and complexity of real-world industrial documentation.
  Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate eight state-of-the-art embedding models for cross-lingual retrieval. Our results show a substantial performance gap between monolingual and cross-lingual settings: for the best-performing model, Recall@10 drops from 0.72 to 0.53 in cross-lingual setting. Retrieval depth also degrades significantly, with relevant documents ranked lower across languages in cross-lingual scenarios. Furthermore, some multilingual embedding models that perform strongly in monolingual settings exhibit sharp declines when queries and documents are in different languages, providing practical insights for model selection in cross-lingual use cases.
  These findings highlight critical limitations of current approaches and emphasize the need for more robust cross-lingual retrieval methods in domain-specific settings. Our benchmark provides actionable insights for model selection and establishes a controlled diagnostic evaluation framework for CLIR over industrial technical text. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/MohammadKhodadad/Multi-Lingual-QAC.

</details>


### [330] [SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23239)
*Nikolaos Kekatos,Theodoros Nestoridis,Charalampos Bratsas,Charalampos Dimoulas,Georgios Konstantinidis,Georgios Malogiannis,Michael Sirivianos,Andreas Veglis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了自动化事实核查系统缺少“warrant（保障）”这一环节，即对判决依据和条件的正式说明，并提出将事实核查领域按形式化水平而非流水线流程进行梳理，总结了现有文献的不足与研究空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动事实核查系统多只输出真假结论，但很少给出明确的判决依据、反例分析或再表述一致性，无法满足监管要求和可审计性需求。欧盟新法案（如数字服务法、人工智能法）要求系统可追溯、可验证，因此有必要系统分析和梳理保障机制缺失的问题。

Method: 作者系统梳理了121篇相关文献，并提出将事实核查领域按“被形式化对象”分为五个层次：声明本身、推理过程、核查系统、谣言传播生态、监管义务，并分析每一层次现有形式化技术的应用与缺口。

Result: 发现大部分相关的形式化工具原本服务于其他领域，极少直接用于事实核查，特别是在对核查系统自身进行验证上存在最大空白。多项事实核查的流程环节长期缺乏明确的正确性标准，尤其是在可核查化表述及纠正已发布判决这两环节上，几乎无形式化方法覆盖。

Conclusion: 自动化事实核查系统在可审计性和形式化保障方面存在显著缺口，需借鉴已有的形式化工具并开发专用方法。论文还列举了未来急需解决的开放性问题，并为每个问题给出了研究建议。

Abstract: An automated fact-checking system returns a label: the claim is true, or it is false. In many such systems the verdict remains the primary output. What is generally missing is a record of which document settled the question, of what would have had to be different for the verdict to change, or of whether the same claim, reworded, would have been judged the same way. We call the missing piece a warrant: a separate statement of what was guaranteed and on what grounds. Formal methods produce evidence of this kind, and regulation is beginning to ask for it, since the Digital Services Act and the AI Act both call for auditable evidence about how systems behave. Surveys of automated fact-checking are usually organised by pipeline stage, and treat logic as one technique among many. We organise the field by what is being formalised instead, which gives five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the system doing the checking, the ecosystem the claim spreads through, and the regulatory obligation. Sorting 121 works into those levels, two patterns stand out. Most of the relevant formal machinery already exists, but it was built for other domains and has rarely been applied here, and the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself. Several stages of the routine professional fact-checkers follow also have no stated correctness criterion, and two of them, writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a verdict already published, are not formally specified in any work we coded. We close with open problems, each with a suggested first step.

</details>


### [331] [Judging a Review by its Cover: A Reliability Analysis of LLM-based Peer Review Evaluation Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23264)
*Shakiba Amirshahi,Sajad Ebrahimi,Hai Son Le,Negar Arabzadeh,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统计框架，测试同行评审自动化评价指标是否能区分内容质量与表面语言表现，并发现现有大部分评价指标容易混淆两者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）作为自动化同行评审“评委”被广泛应用，评价主要依赖指标自动打分，但这些指标可能只是评价了语言表达的流畅度和规范性，而非真正的内容质量，导致评审质量测量存在偏差。在AI辅助评审日益普及的背景下，这一问题尤为重要。

Method: 作者提出以统计框架检验评价指标对“内容不变、语言不同”的评审版本的打分一致性。具体做法是，收集ICLR和NeurIPS 674份人类评审，以及基于大模型重写、完全保留评判内容但改变表达方式的4044份改写版，然后对29种主流评价指标进行敏感性和鲁棒性测试。

Result: 结果显示，在主要分析中，29种指标中有23种在面对白话重写时对同等内容打出了显著不同的分数，只有6种指标通过了鲁棒性测试。此外，这种现象在不同大模型评委下均表现一致，说明问题具有普遍性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，目前大多数同行评审评价指标无法充分区分真正的内容质量与语言表达质量，这会干扰AI评审系统的公正性。建议在正式采用用于AI辅助、人类或AI自动生成评审对比前，必须验证相关指标在“内容不变-表达重写”场景下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Peer-review evaluation is increasingly being automated with LLM-as-a-judge metrics, but this creates a measurement risk. A review may receive a high score because it is fluent, organized, and polished, rather than because it provides a strong evaluation of the paper. This risk is especially important in AI-assisted reviewing, where reviewers may use LLMs to improve clarity or presentation while preserving the underlying judgments. We propose a statistical framework for testing whether peer-review evaluation metrics capture substantive review quality beyond surface-level linguistic form. The framework compares original human reviews with faithful LLM rewrites that preserve the same evaluative content while changing wording and presentation. Using a dataset comprising 4,044 meaning-preserving rewrites derived from 674 human reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS, we evaluate 29 content-oriented peer-review evaluation metrics drawn from four prior works through complementary tests of surface sensitivity and robustness. Although these metrics are intended to capture review properties beyond surface-level, writing-dependent characteristics, we find that sensitivity to rewriting is widespread. Under our primary analysis, 23 metrics assign significantly different scores to reviews whose evaluative content is preserved, while only six satisfy our robustness criterion. The patterns are largely consistent across two LLM judge models, suggesting that the issue is not specific to a single judge. These findings show that many peer-review evaluation metrics partially conflate review quality with linguistic presentation, and indicate that robustness to meaning-preserving rewriting should be validated before such metrics are used to compare human-written, AI-assisted, and AI-generated reviews.

</details>


### [332] [Knowing When to Trust Images: Reliability-Aware Multi-modal Entity Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23267)
*Chenxiao Li,Yunhe Feng,Dongfang Liu,Dong Nie,Yan Huang,Heng Fan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RA-MMEA框架，通过评估和增强视觉模态可靠性，提升多模态实体对齐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态实体对齐方法在融合图像时，未充分考虑图像噪声和语义不匹配问题，导致性能受限。

Method: 提出RA-MMEA框架，包含依赖感知的视觉可靠性预测（DA-VRP）模块和稳定正则化视觉嵌入生成（SR-VEG）模块，前者评估图像的可靠性，后者在文本语义辅助下优化视觉表示。

Result: RA-MMEA在多个实验中取得了SOTA（最优）性能，证明了有效性。

Conclusion: 可靠的视觉模态对实体对齐至关重要，所提RA-MMEA能显著提升对齐效果。

Abstract: The visual modality, i.e., images, plays a key role in multi-modal entity alignment (MMEA). Existing approaches often directly fuse the image with other modalities to align different entities. Although simple, such strategies overlook the potential noise in the images and their semantic misalignment with corresponding entities, resulting in suboptimal fusion and degraded performance. Addressing this, we propose a novel Reliability-Aware framework for MMEA (RA-MMEA), which assesses visual reliability and adaptively improves unreliable visual representations for robust entity alignment. The core lies in two modules, including dependency-aware visual reliability prediction (DA-VRP) and stability-regularized visual embedding generation (SR-VEG). The former aims to estimate the reliability of an image by leveraging multi-modal dependency within the entity, while the latter focuses on producing alternative visual representation conditioned on semantics encoded in textual modalities for multi-modal fusion. Compared to current methods, RA-MMEA enables more reliable visual representations for modality fusion, thereby improving performance. In extensive experiments, RA-MMEA achieves state-of-the-art results, verifying the importance of reliable visual modality for entity alignment and the effectiveness of RA-MMEA. The code and results will be released.

</details>


### [333] [Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23371)
*Yifan Wang,Dejing Dou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种新型机器可解释信息（MII）协议，实现了跨模型（如Llama、Qwen、Mistral）间的文档语义转换、检索、推理和可转移重建，极大降低了长文本推理时的计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强系统中，向量检索高效但模型推理依赖于重新加载冗长文本，注意力成本高昂（O(N^2)）。同时，现有的压缩方法依赖于具体模型架构（私有状态），缺乏通用性。

Method: 提出了MII：文档首先由Writer组件压缩为56个固定带宽token的canonical state，然后通过Translator转到任何冻结的Reader模型的嵌入空间，实现O(K)成本下的推理。并设计了Residual-MII缓存体系，结合全局记忆与稀疏局部证据强化信息重建。

Result: MII能跨LLM（如Llama、Qwen、Mistral）通用，在HotpotQA任务上，Residual-MII模型仅用约7%的注意力FLOPs就超越了全文本精确匹配成绩。此外，机制分析表明该方案能实现可追踪、跨文档零样本的实体级迁移。

Conclusion: 论文证明了基于MII的方案可有效解决长文本推理的计算瓶颈，支持异构LLM间的迁移和强全局推理/检索能力，有望促成新型的可编译、可转移神经文档格式。

Abstract: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. We demonstrate strong cross-model interoperability across heterogeneous LLMs (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) -- despite the Writer using a legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, forcing genuine semantic translation rather than token-level memorization. Mechanistic probes reveal modular latent structure: entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between unrelated document states while remaining decodable. To address lexical reconstruction under fixed bandwidth, we propose Residual-MII, a cache hierarchy combining compiled global memory with sparse local evidence. On HotpotQA (7,405 queries), Residual-MII exceeds full-context Exact Match at approximately 7% of the attention FLOPs, suggesting a paradigm shift toward compiled, transferable neural document formats.

</details>


### [334] [Perplexity Predicts Protection: Choosing Pretrained Backbones for Worst-Client Fairness in Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23463)
*Kiran Naseer,Samreen Azhar,Umar Shoaib,Haroon Mahmood,Muhammad Awais*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文探讨了联邦学习中数据量较少的客户端通常受益较少的问题，并分析了在LoRA微调下，预训练模型选择对表现最差客户端的影响。结果发现，预训练模型在目标文本的单词困惑度可预测其对弱客户端的提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在联邦学习中，虽然整体平均准确率较高，但数据较少的客户端常常效果很差。论文关注于如何通过预判模型适用性，提升这些弱势客户端的最终表现。

Method: 作者在三个文本分类数据集和三种规模相近的预训练模型（RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT）上进行了313组对比实验，使用LoRA微调，并通过在目标文本上的困惑度（perplexity）来预评估不同模型的帮助效果。此外，尝试了Ditto个性化方案，并分析了聚合操作作用。

Result: 较低困惑度的预训练模型显著提升了表现最差客户端，nine组数据-模型组合的秩相关为-0.87，并通过留出模型进行验证。Ditto个性化仅能缩小4-12%的差距，完全移除聚合则收益消失。单个客户端与整体更新方向基本正交，不支持常见的冲突解释。

Conclusion: 在联邦学习应用中，建议使用目标文本困惑度较低的预训练模型，提前评估模型潜力。不应依赖个性化方法来保护数据少客户端的效果。论文已开放代码和全部实验结果，供同行复现和测评。

Abstract: Federated learning lets multiple parties train a shared model without pooling their data, but a client with far less data than the others can end up poorly served even when the group's average accuracy looks fine. We ask whether the choice of pretrained backbone affects this under LoRA fine-tuning, and whether per-word perplexity on the target text predicts which backbone helps the worst-off client before federated training starts. We ran 313 experiments across three text-classification datasets and three similarly sized backbones (RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT), each compared against a task-specific baseline on identical data splits. Lower-perplexity backbones consistently produced larger gains for the worst-performing client, with a rank correlation of -0.87 across nine dataset-backbone pairs; a backbone held out of the analysis confirmed the pattern. Personalization with Ditto recovered only 4-12% of the gap between training alone and full federation, and removing aggregation entirely erased the benefit. A client's update also showed no sign of conflicting with the group's update; the two are close to orthogonal, ruling out one proposed explanation for this failure. Practically: measure perplexity on a sample of task text before choosing a backbone, and do not rely on personalization to protect a data-poor client. We release our code, predictions, and full results for others to test.

</details>


### [335] [Propose, Verify, Commit: Evidence-Grounded Memory for Long-Horizon Multi-Actor Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23465)
*Zihao Lu,Zhihang Yuan,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了EGMEMORY系统，以提升多角色长期对话记忆能力，通过将对话内容建模为可查询状态机，实现信息有效存储和检索，并在多个基准测试中大幅超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时跨度多角色对话中，关键信息分布离散、且会被后续修正，为记忆建模和检索带来很大挑战。现有方法难以综合不同角色和多轮对话中的分散证据，因此需要新方法提升多演员对话的长期记忆力和检索效果。

Method: EGMEMORY将多角色对话长期记忆建模为可查询的状态机，区分持久化消息证据和当前活动状态。写入时采用自适应状态解析和“证据支撑的提出-验证-提交”协议动态更新状态；查询时用自适应证据导航，结合对话结构缩小搜索空间并基于词汇-语义相关性排序候选内容。该系统通过prompting和工具调用实现，无需专门记忆策略训练。

Result: 在GroupMemBench和EverMemBench两个多角色长对话基准上分别取得68.2%和77.9%的效果，较最强对比提升22.7和21.4个百分点。还在LoCoMo二人对话任务上取得73.6%，显示了对不同场景的良好泛化性。

Conclusion: EGMEMORY有效提升了多角色长期对话中的记忆能力与信息检索表现，并且泛化性较好。代码将在正式发表后开源，有望推动该领域进一步发展。

Abstract: Long-horizon conversational memory is especially challenging in multi-actor settings, where relevant evidence is distributed across participants and contexts and previously established information may later be revised. We introduce EGMEMORY, which formulates long-horizon multi-actor memory as a searchable state machine that separates persistent message-level evidence from an explicit active state. At write time, adaptive state resolution and an evidence-grounded propose-verify-commit protocol govern how this state evolves. At read time, adaptive evidence navigation iteratively resolves the state and supporting evidence required for a query, using conversational structure to narrow the search space and lexical-semantic relevance to rank candidates. The system operates through prompting and tool use without memory-specific policy training. EGMEMORY achieves 68.2% on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, outperforming the strongest evaluated baselines by 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points, respectively. It further reaches 73.6% on the dyadic LoCoMo benchmark, demonstrating generalization beyond multi-actor conversations. We will release the codebase upon formal publication.

</details>


### [336] [RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23466)
*Fanyu Zhao,Ruike Cao,Liang Dong,Fugen Yao,Jian Xu,Guanjun Jiang,Han Zhang,Yifei Zhao,Yinsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种新型的参数化记忆系统RPMem，实现了对LLM长期跨会话记忆的高效存储、进化和迁移，超越了现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM记忆体系存在以下不足：文本型记忆在历史信息增多后越来越依赖检索和上下文推理，影响长期效果；参数型记忆虽可编码经验但难以支持跨会话进化，且与底座模型耦合，无法在更换后继续利用已有记忆。

Method: RPMem采用两阶段架构：将每段会话通过前向推理编译为模型无关的潜在记忆，再通过任务训练的循环门控机制将其选择性整合进累计记忆。最终记忆通过LoRA映射为底座专用参数，实现记忆迁移，且便于在底座模型更替时沿用编码能力。

Result: RPMem在三个长期记忆基准和五个不同底座上，展示出广泛的泛化能力、近乎恒定的更新成本和内存占用。在PERMA任务上，Qwen3-8B+RPMem取得85.52%，领先最佳参数记忆和文本记忆基线5.32和12.98个百分点。消融实验验证了会话编译和跨会话整合的互补性，动态分析说明门控机制能学习到针对任务的记忆整合策略。

Conclusion: RPMem确立了一种独立于生命周期和底座模型的参数化记忆框架，能持续进化跨会话记忆并确保其在更换底座后仍可用，为LLM智能体长期任务提供了更优的记忆方案。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.

</details>


### [337] [BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23490)
*Peng Kuang,Yuchun Fan,Jiangnan Li,Minghao Wu,Jialong Tang,Hao-Ran Wei,Weixuan Wang,Jianhong Tu,Baosong Yang,Tong Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了BabelFlow与BabelArena，评估大语言模型（LLM）代理在多语种复杂任务流程中的能力，发现低资源语种代理存在更多工具使用和流程控制类错误，并在任务中更依赖英文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的评测多数集中于英文，难以反映其在多语种环境（特别是低资源语言）中的真实能力和局限，阻碍了多语种智能体的发展与应用。

Method: 作者提出BabelFlow（多语种任务适配流程）及BabelArena（多领域、多语言、多任务实例基准），通过结构保持的翻译、运行依赖分析、多重自动与人工校验，确保任务语义和评价标准跨语种一致，并用五个主流LLM进行实验。

Result: 1. 五个模型在不同任务和语种间表现差异显著，无单一模型全面领先；2. 低资源语言易出现工具用法、控制流程等新类型错误；3. 低资源语种LLM代理输入token数远超英文，但有效交互环节增长有限；4. 结构化输出任务下语言切换现象显著偏向英文。

Conclusion: BabelArena为研究多语种智能体的可靠性和效率提供了新标准。当前LLM在多语种任务中的能力存在明显短板，需针对低资源语言优化，特别是在工具使用和流程管理等方面。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.

</details>


### [338] [Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23551)
*Shuyang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种新的层次旋转位置编码（hRoPE）方法，通过分别编码段落、句子和词元的索引，提高了对文本层次结构的建模能力，并发现基于压缩深度可以更好地区分真实的段落结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的标准位置编码仅用一维的阅读顺序表示位置，不能有效反映文本的层次结构。作者希望改进位置编码，以捕捉段落等多层次结构信息。

Method: 作者提出了层次旋转位置编码（hRoPE），将段落、句子、词元的索引作为独立的通道输入，控制并干预段落坐标，并采用精确的跨段落attention估算。通过与密度匹配的随机标签通道对比，分析压缩行为。

Result: 所有语料库中，层次位置编码的跨段落attention都表现出比基线更高的压缩水平。与随机通道相比，真实结构的压缩更深且与语料相关，而对照组则不具备这种现象。

Conclusion: 压缩的深度（而非压缩发生的位置）能够作为真实段落结构的鲁棒标志；其他语料属性无法完全复现这种层级排序。hRoPE能够有效揭示并表征层次性文本结构。

Abstract: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate p1, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed relative to a token-distance-matched baseline in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too, more shallowly. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression, which is greater and corpus-dependent while the control's is not. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.

</details>


### [339] [Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23573)
*Duy Anh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种简单方法，在合成作文生成中引入错误监督，使其更接近真实人类作文，提升自动作文评分系统（AES）训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成作文缺乏逼真的错误，难以代表实际语言学习者写作，对AES系统提升有限。

Method: 将大语言模型（LLM）微调至带有错误注释的文本（如语法错误检测GED的数据），以生成更具人类学习者特征的合成作文。通过对比真实作文、常规合成作文和新方法生成的作文进行AES评分微调与评估。

Result: 在大数据量下，新方法在12组数据/评价指标中有11组优于常规模型，部分结果接近真实作文训练出的模型。在数据极度稀缺场景下效果不稳定，需到200篇训练作文时才显现较明显优势。

Conclusion: 新方法能更好地模拟学习者错误，提升AES建模能力，在数据较多时效果尤为突出，对后续合成数据生成具有参考价值。

Abstract: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.

</details>


### [340] [ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23582)
*Kuanlin Chen,Chen-Wei Kuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ARID系统，将维护工单中的关键信息自动抽取为固定格式JSON，并能在Jetson Orin NX等嵌入式硬件上高效运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 维护工单需要在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，但后端软件又需要结构化、标准化的输出数据。目前缺乏能够兼顾高效性、准确性与嵌入式适配性的自动抽取方案。

Method: ARID采用双教师过滤、噪声自适应合成训练、每单一路由决策、4-bit低精度推理及语法约束解码等方法，并在模型训练数据集上做特定样本遴选与增强。实验在Jetson Orin NX上运行。

Result: 在无人标注的OMIn数据集(2326条)中保留716对训练样本，并补充99条用于动作抽取。用300条人工标注数据测得token-F1在标准环境下达84.8%、在Jetson部署下为82.9%。推理延迟P50/P99为5310/5656毫秒，功耗12.5W。零样本迁移下语义F1降至46.4%，但解析器成功率仍≥99.8%。

Conclusion: ARID可在嵌入式设备上高效、准确、结构化地抽取维护工单信息，输出格式强适配下游。迁移时输出格式的正确性较好，但字段语义表现下降。

Abstract: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. On zero-shot MaintNet transfer, semantic F1 falls to 46.4% while parser success remains at least 99.8%, showing that output validity transfers but field semantics do not.

</details>


### [341] [On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23587)
*Yifei Yang,Zouying Cao,Xingrui Wang,Xiao Zhou,Yuexian Li,Dongjie Yang,Hai Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了提升大型推理模型(LRM)推理效率的常用方法如量化和剪枝对对抗鲁棒性的影响，发现效率技术降低越狱攻击成功率本质上源于推理能力下降，而非真实安全对齐提升。量化+剪枝是效率与鲁棒性平衡的最优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前为降低大型推理模型高昂推理成本，常用效率技术如量化、剪枝，但这些技术对模型对抗鲁棒性影响未知，因此需要系统研究，为实际部署提供理论依据。

Method: 作者对应用效率技术（量化、剪枝）后的大型推理模型进行了对抗攻击实验，并结合机制分析（表征漂移）探究推理能力、鲁棒性及安全对齐之间的关系。

Result: 研究发现，效率技术（如量化、剪枝）虽然降低了越狱攻击成功率，但这主要是因推理能力下降导致模型无法完成恶意指令，而非真正增强了模型的安全对齐能力。

Conclusion: 大量实验和机制分析显示，效率提升方法降低越狱攻击成功率更多来自能力损失，而非真实安全防护。量化结合剪枝在兼顾效率和鲁棒性的同时效果最好，研究为LRMs安全部署提供了实证基础，也澄清了‘真实性能’与‘能力退化’的区别。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning. However, the impact of these techniques on model adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored. This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the interplay between efficiency, jailbreak vulnerability, and reasoning in LRMs. We find that while efficiency methods seemingly reduce the success rate of jailbreak attacks, this improvement is often superficial. It largely arises from degraded reasoning capabilities leading to "attempted but failed" malicious responses, rather than an increase in genuine alignment. Mechanistic analysis of representational drift confirms this, revealing a strict coupling between reasoning capability loss and the model's inability to maintain malicious semantic trajectories. Additionally, we identify quantization with pruning as the optimal strategy to balance efficiency and robustness. These findings clarify the distinction between true safety alignment and capability-induced failure, providing an empirical foundation for LRM deployment.

</details>


### [342] [Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23697)
*Jie Sun,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Zeyuan Liu,Gengsheng Li,Houcheng Jiang,Yilin Cheng,Bichuan Feng,Yuchen Cai,Junfeng Fang,Xiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需标签的多教师按需蒸馏方法TrustMOPD，实现学生模型能在生成的每一个前缀基于教师能力动态融合多位专家知识，大幅提升在不同领域任务的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的多教师模型通常需要为每个样本选定一个教师，并在整个生成过程中固定这一选择。这不仅依赖于难以获得的标签，还不能适应生成序列中专业需求的动态变化。为了解决上述限制，需要一个能在序列级或更细粒度动态选择教师的无标签方法。

Method: TrustMOPD在学生每次生成前缀后，计算各专家RL微调与基础模型的差异作为置信度指标，校准后据此动态加权教师输出，形成token级别的加权蒸馏目标，无需人工标签。方法适用数学、代码和指令等领域。

Result: TrustMOPD在数学、代码、指令任务中均超越了最强的无标签基线方法，在SingleCap任务上recovery ratio从54.4%跃升到91.5%，MultiCap任务从54.5%提升到98.0%。同时，其效果接近有标签的MOPD方法。

Conclusion: TrustMOPD显著提升了多教师模型的表现，实现了真正意义上的无标签、上下文自适应的知识蒸馏，有效解决了以往方法在标签依赖和序列动态适应上的不足。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD uses each specialist's RL-induced displacement from a shared pre-RL reference as a proxy for local reliability, calibrates these scores across teachers, and constructs a weighted distillation target. Across mathematics, code, and instruction following, TrustMOPD outperforms the strongest label-free baseline, increasing the recovery ratio from $54.4\%$ to $91.5\%$ on \textsc{SingleCap} and from $54.5\%$ to $98.0\%$ on \textsc{MultiCap}, while approaching label-based MOPD on \textsc{SingleCap}. Randomizing token-level weights independently of the student-generated prefix performs no better than uniform weighting, supporting the importance of conditioning supervision on the evolving generation context.

</details>


### [343] [Financial Language Models as Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems for News-Based Trading under Market Frictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23703)
*Kemal Kirtac*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了MFAST框架，将金融语言模型的新闻情感信号转化为可审计、可复现且符合市场实际的交易决策，全面评估其在真实交易场景下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前金融AI在转化和评估金融新闻的决策信号上缺乏统一且与市场实际相符的部署与评测流程，导致模型成果难以直接用于真实金融系统。

Method: 提出MFAST（Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading）框架，将带时间戳的金融文本链接到具体证券，并规避数据泄露、市场摩擦、执行时机等现实因素，通过封闭和公开数据资源的结合，实现可复现评测。

Result: 实验表明，仅解码类语言模型在多项评测（分类、校准、回报预测、投资组合收益等）上优于编码模型和基于词典的情感方法，同时揭示了模型在准确率、延迟、内存、吞吐和成本之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 金融语言模型要实现可信与有用的评估，必须采用结合语言理解、时间管理、市场摩擦感知和可复验证的端到端工程方法。

Abstract: Financial language models can transform unstructured firm-specific news into structured decision signals, but financial AI research lacks an integrated deployment framework for evaluating whether those signals remain useful in financial decision systems. Computer science research has developed strong methods for time-series forecasting, text classification, multimodal stock prediction, graph-based market modeling, and machine-learning operations, yet these streams do not provide a domain-specific protocol that jointly tests financial language-model outputs under event-time observability, probability calibration, execution timing, transaction costs, liquidity constraints, capacity limits, operational diagnostics, and statistical inference. We introduce MFAST, a Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading framework that converts timestamped financial text into auditable, reproducible, and market-feasible trading decisions. The application is news-based trading, where firm-specific text must be linked to securities before portfolio decisions can be evaluated. The framework links Refinitiv News Analytics to Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) equity data, restricts the primary out-of-sample evaluation to post-release news outside disclosed foundation-model data-freshness periods, and adds a public replication arm using open financial text and public price data. Results show that decoder-only language models outperform encoder baselines and dictionary sentiment in classification, calibration, return prediction, and net portfolio performance, while operational diagnostics reveal trade-offs among accuracy, latency, memory, throughput, and inference cost. The paper shows that credible evaluation of financial language models requires an end-to-end engineering approach combining language understanding, temporal discipline, market-friction-aware deployment, and reproducible validation.

</details>


### [344] [STEVE: Stabilizing Textual Gradient-Based Prompt Optimization via Error-Driven Refinement and Regularized Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23716)
*Yifan Xu,Yixuan Li,Xinzhuo Li,Yixin Gu,Yifan Shen,Lijun Yu,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出STEVE框架，有效提升基于文本梯度的提示词优化方法的稳定性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本梯度的自动提示词优化在迭代过程中常出现不稳定，导致性能波动。作者识别出不稳定的两大来源：一是已正确示例产生的梯度噪声，二是对难例的过度拟合使对简单例子性能下降。

Method: 提出STEVE稳定化框架，包含两大机制：（1）‘错误驱动修正’只用错误示例生成梯度，聚焦于信息丰富的失败案例；（2）‘正则化验证’机制将每次更新视为暂定，只有在对困难案例性能提升但对保留集无不可接受的退化时才采纳。

Result: 在十个推理基准、三种不同评估器/优化器和主流提示词优化基线下，STEVE减少了退化，生成更加稳健的提示词。新模型和大样本测试（如gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4、GSM8K-Platinum、DS-1000）实验也验证了效果持续存在。

Conclusion: STEVE框架能有效提升文本梯度提示词优化过程的稳定性与效果，是推进相关自动化提示词优化研究与应用的实用工具。

Abstract: Textual-gradient methods automate prompt optimization through natural-language feedback, but their iterative updates can be unstable. We identify two sources of this instability: noisy gradients produced from already-correct examples and over-specialization to hard cases that degrades performance on simpler inputs. We introduce STEVE, a stabilization framework with two coupled mechanisms. Error-Driven Refinement generates gradients only from incorrectly handled examples, concentrating updates on informative failures. Regularized Verification treats every update as provisional and accepts it only when improvement on hard cases does not cause unacceptable regression on a preservation set. Across ten reasoning benchmarks, three evaluator/optimizer models, and established prompt-optimization baselines, STEVE reduces degradation and produces more robust prompts. Additional evaluations with gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4 on symbolic reasoning, GSM8K-Platinum, and DS-1000 show that these gains persist with newer models and larger test sets. STEVE therefore provides a practical way to improve the stability and effectiveness of textual-gradient prompt optimization.

</details>


### [345] [GRACE: Grounded Adversarial Reasoning over Canadian Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23726)
*Jiakang Xu,Wantong Huo,Udom Silparcha,Jonathan H. Chan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了GRACE数据集，专门针对加拿大联邦法律进行多种法律推理能力测试，并展示了定制模型CLeAR-4B在有无法条支撑下的性能表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律NLP数据集很少评估模型在不完全信息下推理、辩护法学立场或汇总多条法规的能力，且加拿大法律相关资源特别稀缺。

Method: 构建GRACE数据集，包含1915个基于加拿大联邦法律的问题—推理—答案实例，覆盖对抗性辩护、不确定性和应用性推理三种模式。通过切分法律文本、自动生成场景问题、无模型引用核查及LLM质量审核，实现高质量问题筛选。并微调开发模型CLeAR-4B，对比主流基础模型（Qwen3-4B），在不同信息场景下评测效果。

Result: CLeAR-4B在有相关法条支撑时，能够更好地与教师输出保持一致，并展现出较强的法律条文引用能力；若缺乏法规支撑，模型推理与表现显著下降。

Conclusion: GRACE数据集为加拿大法律NLP发展填补空白，可助力开发更轻量且能依赖法规文本有效推理的法律AI模型。

Abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance across a range of legal tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the ability to take and defend a legal position, reason under incomplete information, or synthesize multiple statutory provisions. This gap is particularly pronounced for Canadian law, which remains underrepresented in legal NLP. We introduce GRACE (Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples), a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation. GRACE covers three reasoning modes: adversarial advocacy, uncertainty, and applied reasoning. We develop a pipeline that partitions raw statutory text, generates scenario-based questions and reasoning, and filters examples through model-free citation verification and LLM-based quality auditing. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune CLeAR-4B (Canadian Legal Adversarial Reasoning), a lightweight model for grounded legal reasoning, and evaluate it against the unmodified Qwen3-4B base model in open- and closed-book settings. CLeAR-4B substantially improves agreement with teacher outputs and statutory citation behavior when the relevant act text is provided, while its grounding degrades sharply when the statute is withheld. These results suggest that GRACE can support the development of lightweight legal models that reason more effectively from supplied statutory text.

</details>


### [346] [Constrained Decoding Eliminates Structural Failures in Small LLMs but Reveals a Scale-Dependent Semantic Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23742)
*Akash Chavan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评测了小规模开源大模型（0.6B-4B参数）在结构化输出场景中受限解码(CD)的效果，并提出将结构正确性与语义正确性分开的新评估方法。结果显示CD可以完全消除结构性错误，但对语义准确性提升有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小参数开源大模型被广泛用于JSON生成、函数调用、数据抽取等结构化输出场景，但鲜有研究关注受限解码（如Outlines、XGrammar）与模型规模之间的关系及其对结构和语义输出的影响。

Method: 基准测试5个模型（来自3个模型家族），覆盖14个结构化输出任务，在三种解码条件（原生、Outlines、XGrammar）下运行。创新性地将评估指标区分为结构正确性（是否符合schema）和语义正确性（内容准确性），系统分析CD对两者的影响。

Result: 受限解码能够让所有模型结构正确率提升至100%，即完全消除schema不合规输出。但在内容准确性方面，CD仅能解决类型强制失败，复杂的指令语义（如多步函数调用）依然表现较差，且与模型规模有关。

Conclusion: 结构合规是达到语义正确的前提条件但不是充分条件。受限解码只能保证schema符合，但无法跨越模型本身的语义理解能力极限。未来提升小模型多步推理等复杂语义能力尤为关键。

Abstract: Small open-source large language models (LLMs) in the 0.6B-4B parameter range are increasingly deployed for structured output generation (JSON, function calling, data extraction), yet little is known about how constrained decoding (CD) interacts with model scale in this regime. We benchmark five models from three families across 14 structured-output tasks under three decoding conditions (native, Outlines, XGrammar). We introduce a two-axis evaluation that separates structural correctness (schema validity) from semantic correctness (content accuracy). We find that CD eliminates all structural failures across all models (schema validity: 78.6-92.9% to 100%), but content accuracy reveals a persistent semantic gap that is scale-dependent: type coercion failures are fully CD-rescuable, while instruction-semantic failures (e.g., multi-step function calling) remain CD-resistant. Schema conformance is necessary but not sufficient for semantic correctness; CD's reach ends exactly where schema conformance ends.

</details>


### [347] [FLARE: A Full-Lifecycle Dense Supervision Paradigm for Long-Horizon Coding Agents via Generative Reward Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23808)
*Jingxuan Xu,Gang Wu,Yanan Wu,Yutao Mou,Songwei Yu,Tianzhuang He,Zhengshuo Gong,Zhao Liu,Zihang Xu,Wenqiang Zhu,Xinping Lei,Weihao Li,Yuhui Bai,Zhongqiu Wang,Yan Wu,Ariel Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了FLARE方法，通过引入轻量化的生成奖励模型（GRM）实现对大语言模型（LLM）代理长周期软件工程任务的密集监督，有效缓解稀疏奖励下的信号分配危机。结果显示FLARE显著提升代理性能，且大幅节省计算资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型代理在处理长周期软件工程任务时，测试时尺度扩展能提升效果，但由于Pass/Fail等稀疏二元奖励，导致信号分配困难和大量失败探索轨迹被浪费。现有方法依赖启发式状态重用或滞后评分，成本高、结构受限，缺乏因果诊断和在线指导。

Method: 作者提出FLARE框架：1）离线利用RADAR因果诊断框架，为GRM提供非依赖回溯的高质量监督信号；2）FLARE在推理时主动捕获高风险步骤并局部重执行以降低算力开销；3）通过GRM提供的结构化信号，实现SFT的排序与RL中的密集奖励，从而避免策略塌缩。

Result: FLARE相比全局Rollout策略在N=1时便可实现更优表现，并将token消耗降低5倍。进一步用于训练时，在长周期交互任务的稀疏奖励环境下，SFT相对提升19.13%，RL提升9.19%。

Conclusion: FLARE为全生命周期大语言模型代理的优化开辟新前沿，不仅提升效率，还有效解决稀疏奖励下的性能瓶颈，对长周期任务和计算资源受限场景具有重要意义。

Abstract: While test-time scaling enhances Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon software engineering (SWE), sparse binary rewards (Pass/Fail) create a severe credit assignment crisis and waste failed exploratory trajectories. Current trajectory optimization and scaling methods are costly and structurally limited, relying on heuristic state reuse without causal diagnosis or delayed scalar scoring without actionable online guidance. We propose FLARE (Full-Lifecycle Alignment and Reward Engine), a novel dense supervision paradigm driven by a lightweight Generative Reward Model (GRM). First, RADAR, an offline causal-aware diagnostic framework, extracts high-fidelity, hindsight-free supervision through causal-chain backtracking to distill a GRM providing real-time, step-level risk feedback. Second, FLARE uses this GRM to continuously optimize the agent across its entire lifecycle. During inference, FLARE acts as an Active Scaffold, autonomously intercepting high-risk generation steps for localized breakpoint re-execution, drastically reducing compute overhead. During post-training, the GRM's structured signals serve as process-supervised reranking scores for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and step-level dense rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL), mitigating policy collapse in sparse environments. Extensive evaluations show that FLARE establishes a new Pareto frontier across the agent lifecycle: FLARE (N=1) outperforms Global Rollout (N=5) with a 5x reduction in token consumption. Extending FLARE to training overcomes the sparse reward problem in long-horizon interactive tasks, delivering relative performance gains of 19.13% in SFT through process-aware data curation and a consistent 9.19% improvement in RL.

</details>


### [348] [Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs: Architecture and Aggregation Strategy Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23825)
*Jordi Luque,Aleix Sant,Fernando López*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了联邦学习（FL）在多语种语音识别（ASR）的表现，比较了四种Speech-LLM架构和不同参数配置下的效果，并给出实际部署建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着隐私需求上升，多语种ASR模型需在分布式环境下训练，联邦学习成为解决敏感数据集中学习的关键技术，但其在多语种语音场景下的最佳做法尚不明确。

Method: 作者在Multilingual LibriSpeech数据集上，采用FedAvg和FedProx两种联邦学习算法，比较冻结与非冻结编码器设置下，独立优化语音编码器、连接器、解码器各自学习率对模型表现的影响。并比较了不同Speech-LLM架构（如EuroLLM、TinyLlama）的适应能力。

Result: 实验发现：针对编码器、连接器、解码器分别调整学习率能显著降低错误率；同时对三部分（encoder和decoder用LoRA微调，connector全部训练）进行适应效果最佳。FedProx的效果依赖于架构，对多语种预训练模型（如EuroLLM）优势更明显，尤其是固定编码器时。

Conclusion: 模型主干能力影响联邦学习对异质数据分布的适应力。具体学习率和参数微调策略对于部署高效多语种Speech-LLM至关重要，这为隐私敏感、分布式场景下的实际应用提供了明确指导。

Abstract: We present a comprehensive benchmark of Federated Learning (FL) for multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), evaluating four Speech-LLM architectures on the Multilingual LibriSpeech dataset. We compare FedAvg and FedProx across frozen and unfrozen encoder configurations, demonstrating that optimized learning rates are critical for performance. Specifically, independently tuning the learning rates for the speech encoder, connector, and decoder yields the lowest error rates, with full three-component adaptation (LoRA for encoder and decoder, full training for the connector) producing the best FL results. We observe that FedProx efficacy is architecture-dependent, providing notable advantages in multilingual pre-trained architectures (e.g., EuroLLM over TinyLlama when keeping the encoder fixed); this indicates that LLM backbone capacity plays a key role in mediating resilience to heterogeneous data distributions. These findings offer concrete design guidance for deploying multilingual Speech-LLMs in privacy-sensitive, distributed environments.

</details>


### [349] [From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23853)
*Camilla Andreozzi,Phuong-Anh Nguyen-Le,Zhijing Jin,Revati Mani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的流程，将灾害风险减缓档案中的文本事件转化为可地理参考的事件数据库。该方法在联合国减少灾害风险办公室（UNDRR）的知识库文档中应用，显著优于传统方法，并公开了相关工具和成果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统灾害数据库如EM-DAT无法直接处理历史档案中的自然语言叙述文本，导致重要灾害信息难以结构化利用。因此，亟需自动化工具将文本档案转为标准化、可分析的数据库记录。

Method: 研发了一套基于受控词表和固定数据结构的LLM流程，自动抽取地理信息并生成事件记录，所有候选信息均保留文本证据以供复查。大规模应用于PreventionWeb知识库，结果与传统spaCy地名处理方法和多种LLM进行对比实验。

Result: 流程从10,000份文档中抽取3572条事件记录，涵盖24种灾害类型，81%地名成功匹配至OpenStreetMap。基于GPT-5模型，属性F1值达86.0%，显著高于spaCy基线的44.2%；在10种LLM中表现最佳（GPT-5.4为86.6%）。文本追溯性证据为72.0%（GPT-5），47.2%（GPT-5.4）。

Conclusion: LLM流程显著提升灾害文本档案结构化能力，可极大助力国家级信息归档与灾害数据库建设。相关模型提示、流程和产出将公开，便于推广至其他档案利用场景。

Abstract: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.

</details>


### [350] [Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23880)
*Soyeon Kim,Hyunjin Kim,JinYeong Bak,Steven Euijong Whang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种新的时间信息检索（TIR）方法Q-TIE，通过学习的时间意图提取来提升时序相关性检索效果，解决现有方法各自的局限性，实验中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于检索增强生成（RAG）的方法兴起，检索到的证据如果时间不匹配将可能产生误导，因此亟需既符合语义又符合时间要求的文档检索方法。已有的时间信息检索主要有两类范式：时间检索器（重表示）和时间重排序器（重约束），但各有不足。

Method: 提出Q-TIE框架，利用学习型的时间意图提取（TIE）模型，将查询的时间约束表示为统一的时间区间（<t_start, t_end>），结合了时间检索器和重排序器各自优点，在无需预设规则的情况下显式建模时间约束。

Result: Q-TIE在多种时间查询任务上均优于现有TIR方法，展现了更强的泛化性，并且可作为轻量级插件集成到时间感知的RAG系统中。

Conclusion: Q-TIE方法通过模型学习显式建模时间信号，有效整合现有两大类TIR范式优点，兼具泛化能力和实际效果，是促进时间相关检索与生成任务结合的有力工具。

Abstract: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.

</details>


### [351] [this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23886)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了this-that-model-1.0，这是一款2B参数的高效决策模型，针对特定分类决策任务，能直接输出选项而无需生成文本，大幅加快推理速度同时降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模型调用通常需要文本生成、过多延迟和费用，不适合高效批量决策场景。作者希望通过结构化输出和模型内状态读取，实现低延迟、低成本且易于集成的自动决策。

Method: 设计了仅对隐藏状态中的特定位置直接读取答案、并限制输出为声明选项集的神经模型，实现不生成文本而直接做出结构化决策；并与主流API和托管模型对比性能和准确率。

Result: 在68道三方决策题测试中，模型Brier分数0.042、准确率0.941，显著优于托管服务的0.133/0.765。单张消费级GPU每秒32次决策，耗电及成本极低。缺点为多步算术题成绩较低（0.560），仅靠一次前向传播难以处理此类任务。

Conclusion: this-that-model-1.0在决策类任务上显著提升了速度、降低了费用且保持精准，适合需本地化、安全、高效决策的场景，但在多步推理任务上仍有限制。模型已开源。

Abstract: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0

</details>


### [352] [Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23916)
*Fırat Öncel,Salman Hussain Ali,Mirco Ravanelli,Cem Subakan,Çağatay Yıldız*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究了大语言模型（LLMs）在预训练结束后知识随时间落后，通过增量式持续预训练（CPT）来缓解时效性问题，并系统分析其知识获取、代价、最佳实践以及部署表现。实验结果显示只需极低代价即可更新模型知识，无需从头训练，并总结出高质量数据小样本即可带来显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型一旦预训练结束，其知识便开始滞后，但完全重训代价极高。虽然持续预训练（CPT）是理想方案，但此前研究多关注在数据完全不重叠的情境下，缺乏对Web规模、时间递增、URL高度重叠等真实场景的系统性分析。因此，作者致力于弥补这一空白，探索一种现实可行的知识及时性迭代方案。

Method: 作者以FineWeb-Edu数据集中不同时间点（严格在知识截止点之后）采集爬取数据，对六个开源模型（覆盖OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2和Gemma-3-1B三大系列，四种参数规模）的时间增量CPT表现进行量化。主要通过四类问题梳理实证：1) 能否补充新知识及有无遗忘现象；2) 增量成本；3) 有效的数据量与质量配置、学习率与参数效率（如LoRA）；4) 零样本微调后增益传递与稳健性。

Result: 主要实验发现：（1）五个模型能有效增加新知识且未出现严重遗忘，并且提升趋势受控于token预算与参数比；（2）绝大部分任务下性能提升代价极低（十三项任务平均变化≤0.01）；（3）高质量小规模数据（6B tokens）即可媲美40B；最佳学习率范围（知识/通才能力最优点相差约10倍）；足够LoRA秩已可拟合全量CPT效果；（4）CPT提升能转移到后续指令调优阶段，DPO的转移效果依模型家族而异。

Conclusion: 现实增量式CPT在知识迭代、资源消耗与模型能力方面具有积极意义，效果远比经典持续学习场景下预期更优。数据质量比数量更关键，LoRA等轻量增量技术实用，推荐此范式作为Web规模LLM知识更新的现实方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B).
  We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.

</details>


### [353] [Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23935)
*Jord Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究了语言模型在助手人格（assistant persona）设定下，对用户发言的影响，发现助手的偏好不仅影响自己的发言，也影响对用户发言的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 希望理解chat型大语言模型经后训练（post-training）添加助手人格后，这种人格是否只影响助手自身发言，还是对对话过程中其他角色（如用户）的输出也有影响，尤其是与安全相关的偏好。

Method: 通过实验测试大模型在助手人格被注入（偏好无害任务）后，分析模型在用户轮次预测结果时该偏好是否仍然存在，对不同模型结构和微调过程进行对比分析。

Result: 结果显示助手偏好（如安全性）不仅存在于助手发言，还延伸到模型对于用户发言的预测；该偏好通过post-training出现，并随模型规模扩大而增强，即使只在助手回合微调也能影响到用户轮次的输出。

Conclusion: post-training带来的助手人格并不局限于本地回合，而是泛化到模型对用户的表示，对模型整体行为有深入、全面的影响。

Abstract: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.

</details>


### [354] [XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23939)
*Zhengxuan Wu,Yuxuan Li,Oyvind Tafjord,Been Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一个用于评估AI在XY问题（用户误导性提问）情景下表现的框架，并发现当前主流模型易被用户误导，缺乏有效沟通和推理的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协作过程中，用户常因XY问题导致与AI沟通失效，但现有评测大多未关注AI是否能识别并抵御这类误导。研究动机在于系统性地评估AI在面对误导性建议时的表现和沟通能力。

Method: 作者提出了XYEval评测框架，将现有测试集转化为XY问题测试，并在6个不同基准套件上评测了5种模型，分析其面对XY问题时的表现下降。同时，利用$τ^2$-bench考查了模型在“吹毛求疵型”用户场景下的表现，结合行为链路分析揭示XY问题影响模型过程。

Result: 结果显示，所有模型在XY问题场景下均出现显著性能下降，最大降幅达46.7%。在需要详细解释时，降幅更大。简单强化AI识别XY问题的提示只能部分缓解问题。行为分析揭示了模型易被“误导性建议”吸引之因。

Conclusion: 现有AI模型仍难以有效识别和沟通XY问题，仅靠简单的提示难以根本解决。提升AI认知与表达的能力是未来的重要挑战。

Abstract: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $τ^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.

</details>


### [355] [HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23951)
*Devangi Sharma,Sophia Judicke,Glenda Tan,Conrad Schaumburg,Shinji Watanabe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的系统HaikuS2S，通过联合语音识别、LLM生成和针对俳句的TTS微调，实现了结构化俳句诗歌朗诵的自然语音合成，在韵律和语调上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有诗歌TTS虽然能表达诗歌的情感和语调，但对于如俳句这类有严格音节结构和句末停顿的诗体处理不足，因此需要专门的方法提升俳句朗读的自然性和表现力。

Method: 提出HaikuS2S级联系统：先用自动语音识别和大语言模型生成俳句文本，再用在散文和定制俳句数据集上微调的TTS进行语音合成。系统在韵律、情感相似性和语音质量上做对比实验。

Result: 实验显示，经过俳句和通用诗歌数据集联合微调的系统，在韵律和语调对齐方面有明显提升，且所有系统在情感相似性上分数相当。

Conclusion: 通过专门针对俳句结构的微调，能够显著提升合成俳句诗歌语音的韵律和表现力，为结构化诗歌TTS发展提供了新方向。

Abstract: Expressive speech synthesis has advanced through prosody modeling, yet generating structured poetic speech, such as haiku, remains challenging. Prior work on prosody transfer improves expressiveness, and fine-tuned poetry TTS (text-to-speech) systems capture verse intonation. However, these models do not model haiku's 5-7-5 syllable structure or line-ending pauses. We present a cascaded system, HaikuS2S, combining ASR (automatic speech recognition), LLM (large language model)-generated haiku, and TTS fine-tuning on both prose and custom haiku datasets. Our evaluation focuses on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment. In our experiments, we see that our prosody and tonal alignment improve significantly with our fine-tuned systems, particularly the one trained on both general poetry and haiku. We also see that we maintain similar emotion similarity scores across all systems.

</details>


### [356] [Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23955)
*Mai Mohamed Eida,Ryan Dolan,Paul de Nijs,Jonathan Dunn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了主流大模型（LLM）对埃及阿拉伯语中次要方言Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic（SEA）的偏见，以及这种偏见对下游任务性能的影响，发现相比主流方言Cairene Egyptian Arabic（CEA），LLM对SEA存在显著偏见且导致下游表现下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自然语言处理（NLP）领域关于埃及阿拉伯语研究主要集中在更具声望的开罗方言（CEA），导致其它较少关注方言如Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic（SEA）在大模型和语料库中代表性不足。作者关心这种代表性缺失是否影响大模型对SEA的接受度以及最终下游应用中的性能。

Method: 作者首先通过基于目标化句法评估（TSE）任务，考查SEA方言特征对多种大模型偏好性的影响，以检测大模型对SEA的上游偏见；然后分析这些方言特征在MMLU基准下游任务中的影响，通过性能变化来评估上游偏见是否会转化为实际应用中的效果下降。

Result: 实验发现，大模型在上游句法任务中对SEA存在显著偏见，对SEA的接受性较低；在下游MMLU基准评测中，模型在SEA数据上的表现也明显下降。

Conclusion: 本文结果表明，大模型中对次方言变异的偏见不仅存在且会影响下游性能，强调了未来NLP需更好地处理子方言变异对语言技术的影响。

Abstract: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.

</details>


### [357] [Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23959)
*Simiao Ren,Kidus Zewde,Xingyu Shen,Yuchen Zhou,Dennis Ng,Ankit Raj,Tommy Duong,Yuxin Zhang,Neo Tiangratanakul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出并测试了用于手机诈骗电话筛查的高效概率读出方法JevLite，显著加快了决策速度，同时保持与LLM判定不相上下的准确性和校准能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在电话诈骗筛查场景下，需要在极短时间（毫秒级）根据每次对话回合给出可靠的判骗概率。现有方法大多依赖文本生成或判定速度较慢，难以实时部署。

Method: 作者使用JevLite（一种无需文本生成的概率输出机制）对Qwen3-4B进行LoRA微调，通过温度缩放的softmax直接在两个label上输出概率P(scam)，并结合ensemble与决策校准，测试了其在41个合成通话场景中的判骗效果，同时与LLM判官和fine-tuned ModernBERT进行对比。

Result: JevLite实现了AUROC 0.974，校准误差0.052，误报为0，决策比LLM判官快1.14个回合，单卡每决策仅64.5ms，远快于传统生成方法，也不逊于ModernBERT，结果报告包含了准确性、校准、误报和决策延迟等多指标。

Conclusion: 虽然没有方法或结构上的新颖点，JevLite在电话诈骗筛查领域的应用及其高效的概率决策输出、卓越的校准与速度表现，展示了通用模型经合理读出与校准后的实用价值。
